paite: TOUPA kiang a kipahthu gen leh Tungnungpen aw, na min phat a lasak thil hoih ahi.
heading: Sabbath Phatna La

paite: Zingsang a na zahngaihna hihlat leh, zan teng a na ginomna hihlat,
thil tumtheih gui sawm neite, pekgingte, kaihging tum khasiathuaite toh, ahoih hi.
TOUPA, nang nna na sep in na hon kipaksak a, na khut thilhihte ziak in nuam in la ka sa ding hi.
TOUPA aw, na thilhihte thupi hi na tel e! Na ngaihtuahnate thuk hi na lawmlawm e!
Mimawl in hiai athei kei hi; mihai in atheisiam sam kei hi.
Migilou-saloute loupa bang a ahong nou ua, thil hihkhialte tengteng a hong phat letlot un, tangtawn a ding ahihman a hong om ding uh ahi, chih.
TOUPA aw, nang zaw tangtawn a ding a sangpi a om gige na hi.
TOUPA aw, ngai dih, nang hon doute, ngai dih, nang hon doute amangthang dek uhi; thil hihkhial tengteng hihzak in a-om vek ding uhi.
Himahleh gam bawngtal kii bang in ka kii na pahtawi a; sathau thak ka nilhta hi.
Ka mit in leng ka galte tung a ka thudeih amu dia, ka bil in kei hon dou gilou- saloute tung a ka thudeih aza ding.
Midiktat tum sing bang in akhanpha ding a; Lebanon tang a sidar sing bang in akhang huthut ding hi.
TOUPA' inn a suan a omte i Pathian huangsung intual ah akhanpha ding uhi.
Upat nung in leng agah lailai ding ua; tuipai kiihkeih in ahing dipdip ding uhi.
TOUPA diktat ahi chih theihsakna ding in; amah ka suangpi ahi a, amah ah diktatlouhna himhim a-om kei hi.
